title.narrative: Program for the Development of Emerging Tourist Destinations.
Programa de Desarrollo de Destinos Tursticos Emergentes.

description.narrative: El objetivo de la CCLIP es contribuir a la generacin de empleo y renta en destinos emergentes, consolidando la actividad turstica como factor de equilibrio territorial. El objetivo de la segunda operacin individual es incrementar el gasto turstico en tres destinos emergentes (Corredor de la Cuenca Baja del Ro Santa Luca; Eje Norte Minas CorralesTacuaremb; Calera de las Hurfanas), al ser el insumo que gatilla el empleo y renta a nivel local

The objective of the CCLIP is to help generate employment and income in emerging destinations, consolidating tourism activity as a factor in balanced regional development. The objective of the second individual operation is to increase tourism spending in three emerging destinations (Lower Santa Luca River Basin Corridor; Minas Corrales-Tacuaremb Northern Corridor; and Calera de las Hurfanas), as tourism is an input that triggers employment and income at the local level
